words.definition: To successfully complete a task or goal
words.example: She worked hard to accomplish her dream.

gloss.es: Completar con éxito una tarea u objetivo.

gloss_example.es: Trabajó duro para lograr su sueño.

words.definition: To obtain or gain something
words.example: He managed to acquire a rare painting.

gloss.es: Obtener o conseguir algo.

gloss_example.es: Logró adquirir una pintura muy valiosa.

words.definition: To publicly support or recommend a cause
words.example: She advocates for better public education.

gloss.es: Apoyar o recomendar públicamente una causa o posición.

gloss_example.es: Ella defiende una mejor educación pública.

words.definition: To examine something in detail to understand it
words.example: Scientists analyze data to find patterns.

gloss.es: Examinar algo en detalle para comprenderlo.

gloss_example.es: Los científicos analizan los datos para encontrar patrones.

words.definition: To evaluate or estimate the nature of something
words.example: The doctor will assess your condition.

gloss.es: Evaluar o estimar la naturaleza o el estado de algo.

words.definition: To make something less confused and more clearly comprehensible
words.example: Could you clarify what you mean by that?

gloss.es: Hacer algo menos confuso y más fácil de entender.

gloss_example.es: ¿Podrías aclarar qué quieres decir con eso?

words.definition: To work jointly with others on an activity
words.example: The teams collaborated to finish the project.

gloss.es: Trabajar conjuntamente con otros en una actividad.

gloss_example.es: Los equipos colaboraron para terminar el proyecto.

words.definition: To give something to a shared goal or result
words.example: Everyone can contribute to making the world better.

gloss.es: Aportar algo a un objetivo o resultado compartido.

gloss_example.es: Todos pueden contribuir a mejorar el mundo.

words.definition: To show clearly by giving evidence or example
words.example: She demonstrated the correct technique.

gloss.es: Mostrar algo claramente con evidencia o un ejemplo.

words.definition: To discover the facts or cause of something
words.example: Scientists worked hard to determine the cause.

gloss.es: Descubrir los hechos o la causa de algo.

gloss_example.es: Los científicos trabajaron duro para determinar la causa.

words.definition: To add more detail or explanation to something
words.example: Can you elaborate on your idea?

gloss.es: Añadir más detalles o explicación a algo ya dicho o escrito.

words.definition: To become known or come out into view
words.example: New technologies continue to emerge every year.

gloss.es: Volverse conocido o salir a la vista.

gloss_example.es: Cada año continúan emergiendo nuevas tecnologías.

words.definition: To give special importance or attention to something
words.example: The teacher emphasized the importance of reading.

gloss.es: Dar especial importancia o atención a algo.

gloss_example.es: El maestro enfatizó la importancia de la lectura.

words.definition: To set up or found something permanently
words.example: They established a new company last year.

gloss.es: Crear o fundar algo de forma permanente.

gloss_example.es: Establecieron una nueva empresa el año pasado.

words.definition: To form an idea of the amount or value of something
words.example: We need to evaluate the risks carefully.

gloss.es: Formarse una idea del valor o la importancia de algo.

gloss_example.es: Necesitamos evaluar los riesgos con cuidado.

words.definition: To develop gradually over time
words.example: Languages evolve over hundreds of years.

gloss.es: Desarrollarse gradualmente a lo largo del tiempo.

gloss_example.es: Los idiomas evolucionan a lo largo de cientos de años.

words.definition: To grow or develop in a healthy way, to thrive
words.example: With proper care, the business will flourish.

gloss.es: Crecer o desarrollarse de manera saludable, prosperar.

gloss_example.es: Con el cuidado adecuado, el negocio prosperará.

words.definition: To produce or create something
words.example: Solar panels generate clean electricity.

gloss.es: Producir o crear algo.

gloss_example.es: Los paneles solares generan electricidad limpia.

words.definition: To put a plan or decision into effect
words.example: They plan to implement the new system next week.

gloss.es: Poner en práctica un plan o una decisión.

gloss_example.es: Planean implementar el nuevo sistema la próxima semana.

words.definition: To point out or show, to be a sign of
words.example: The data indicates a rise in temperatures.

gloss.es: Señalar o mostrar algo, ser una señal de ello.

gloss_example.es: Los datos indican un aumento de las temperaturas.

words.definition: To explain or understand the meaning of something
words.example: It is hard to interpret his body language.

gloss.es: Explicar o comprender el significado de algo.

gloss_example.es: Es difícil interpretar su lenguaje corporal.

words.definition: To carry out a systematic inquiry to discover facts
words.example: Police are investigating the incident.

gloss.es: Llevar a cabo una investigación sistemática para descubrir hechos.

gloss_example.es: La policía está investigando el incidente.

words.definition: To reduce something to the smallest possible amount
words.example: We should minimize waste in our daily lives.

gloss.es: Reducir algo a la mínima expresión posible.

gloss_example.es: Deberíamos minimizar el desperdicio en nuestra vida diaria.

words.definition: To find your way through a complex situation or place
words.example: She navigated the busy streets with ease.

gloss.es: Encontrar el camino a través de una situación o lugar complejo.

gloss_example.es: Navegó por las concurridas calles con facilidad.

words.definition: To succeed in dealing with a problem or difficulty
words.example: She overcame her fear of public speaking.

gloss.es: Lograr manejar un problema o dificultad con éxito.

gloss_example.es: Superó su miedo a hablar en público.

words.definition: To continue despite difficulty or discouragement
words.example: You must persevere if you want to achieve your goals.

gloss.es: Continuar a pesar de las dificultades o el desaliento.

gloss_example.es: Debes perseverar si quieres alcanzar tus metas.

words.definition: To cause someone to believe or do something through reasoning
words.example: She persuaded me to try the new restaurant.

gloss.es: Convencer a alguien de creer o hacer algo mediante la razón.

gloss_example.es: Me persuadió para probar el nuevo restaurante.

words.definition: To treat something as more important than other things
words.example: You must learn to prioritize your tasks.

gloss.es: Tratar algo como más importante que otras cosas.

gloss_example.es: Debes aprender a priorizar tus tareas.

words.definition: To make practical and effective use of something
words.example: We should utilize all available resources.

gloss.es: Hacer uso práctico y efectivo de algo.

gloss_example.es: Deberíamos utilizar todos los recursos disponibles.

words.definition: To deduce a fact or conclusion from evidence and reasoning rather than direct statement
words.example: From the tone of the letter, we can infer that she was deeply disappointed.

gloss.es: Deducir un hecho o conclusión a partir de evidencias y razonamiento, sin que se declare directamente.

gloss_example.es: Por el tono de la carta, podemos inferir que estaba profundamente decepcionada.

words.definition: To examine something very carefully and critically in every detail
words.example: The auditors scrutinized every transaction from the past five years.

gloss.es: Examinar algo muy detenida y críticamente en cada detalle.

gloss_example.es: Los auditores escudriñaron cada transacción de los últimos cinco años.

words.definition: To make two apparently contradictory things compatible, or to restore a relationship after conflict
words.example: It is difficult to reconcile his public statements with his actual voting record.

gloss.es: Hacer compatibles dos cosas aparentemente contradictorias, o restaurar una relación tras un conflicto.

gloss_example.es: Es difícil reconciliar sus declaraciones públicas con su historial de votos real.

words.definition: To recognize or perceive something that is not immediately obvious or easy to distinguish
words.example: Even experienced critics struggle to discern genuine talent from mere novelty.

gloss.es: Reconocer o percibir algo que no es inmediatamente obvio o fácil de distinguir.

gloss_example.es: Hasta los críticos experimentados tienen dificultades para discernir el talento genuino de la mera novedad.

words.definition: To find a clever or indirect way to overcome a rule, restriction, or difficulty
words.example: The new regulation was designed to prevent companies from circumventing tax obligations.

gloss.es: Encontrar una manera ingeniosa o indirecta de superar una norma, restricción o dificultad.

gloss_example.es: La nueva regulación fue diseñada para evitar que las empresas eludieran sus obligaciones fiscales.

words.definition: To make something impossible or prevent it from happening in advance
words.example: His prior conviction effectively precludes him from holding public office.

gloss.es: Hacer algo imposible o impedir que ocurra de antemano.

gloss_example.es: Su condena anterior le impide de manera efectiva ocupar un cargo público.

words.definition: To become bigger or to develop over time.
words.example: These flowers grow quickly in spring.

gloss.es: Hacerse más grande o desarrollarse.

gloss_example.es: Estas flores crecen rápido en primavera.

words.definition: To start to be seen, or to seem.
words.example: A rainbow appeared after the rain.

gloss.es: Empezar a verse, o dar la impresión.

gloss_example.es: Apareció un arcoíris tras la lluvia.

words.definition: To lift something to a higher position.
words.example: Please raise your hand to answer.

gloss.es: Poner algo en una posición más alta.

words.definition: To suddenly understand or become aware of something.
words.example: I realized I had left my keys at home.

gloss.es: Comprender de pronto o notar algo.

gloss_example.es: Me di cuenta de que dejé las llaves en casa.

words.definition: To speak briefly about something.
words.example: She mentioned a new restaurant nearby.

gloss.es: Hablar brevemente de algo.

words.definition: To form a picture of something in your mind.
words.example: Imagine living by the sea.

gloss.es: Formar una imagen de algo en la mente.

words.definition: To think about something with curiosity.
words.example: I wonder what time it is.

gloss.es: Pensar en algo con curiosidad.

words.definition: To look at how things are similar or different.
words.example: Let's compare the two phones.

gloss.es: Ver en qué se parecen o difieren las cosas.

words.definition: To be in charge of, or to succeed in doing something difficult.
words.example: She manages a small team.

gloss.es: Estar a cargo de algo, o conseguir algo difícil.

words.definition: To succeed in reaching a goal.
words.example: He achieved his dream of traveling the world.

gloss.es: Tener éxito en alcanzar una meta.

gloss_example.es: Logró su sueño de viajar por el mundo.

words.definition: To show your thoughts or feelings in words.
words.example: It is hard to express how I feel.

gloss.es: Mostrar pensamientos o sentimientos con palabras.

gloss_example.es: Es difícil expresar cómo me siento.

words.definition: To give or show something to others.
words.example: She presented her idea to the class.

gloss.es: Dar o mostrar algo a otros.

gloss_example.es: Presentó su idea a la clase.

words.definition: To stay in the same place or state.
words.example: Please remain seated.

gloss.es: Quedarse en el mismo lugar o estado.

words.definition: To include as a necessary part.
words.example: The job involves a lot of travel.

gloss.es: Incluir como parte necesaria.

words.definition: To find the size or amount of something.
words.example: Measure the table before you buy it.

gloss.es: Averiguar el tamaño o cantidad de algo.

gloss_example.es: Mide la mesa antes de comprarla.

words.definition: To finish something, or having all parts.
words.example: Please complete the form.

gloss.es: Terminar algo, o que tiene todas sus partes.

words.definition: To use force against someone, or a struggle.
words.example: They had a fight over money.

gloss.es: Usar la fuerza contra alguien, o una disputa.

words.definition: To think something is probably true.
words.example: I suppose you are right.

gloss.es: Pensar que algo es probablemente cierto.

words.definition: To see a connection between things.
words.example: The two events are related.

gloss.es: Ver una conexión entre cosas.

words.definition: To have something inside.
words.example: This box contains old photos.

gloss.es: Tener algo dentro.

words.definition: To admire someone and treat them well.
words.example: I respect her decision.

gloss.es: Admirar a alguien y tratarlo bien.

words.definition: To make an effort to achieve something difficult.
words.example: She attempted to fix the car.

gloss.es: Tratar de hacer algo.

words.definition: To not succeed in doing something.
words.example: He failed the driving test.

gloss.es: No tener éxito en algo.

words.definition: To say what you think about something.
words.example: She commented on the news.

gloss.es: Decir lo que piensas de algo.

words.definition: To happen.
words.example: The accident occurred at night.

gloss.es: Suceder algo.

words.definition: To not have enough of something.
words.example: The plan lacks detail.

gloss.es: No tener suficiente de algo.

words.definition: To get more of something.
words.example: He gained a lot of experience.

gloss.es: Conseguir más de algo.

words.definition: To show that something is true.
words.example: Can you prove it?

gloss.es: Mostrar que algo es verdad.

words.definition: To mention or point to something.
words.example: He referred to the first chapter.

gloss.es: Mencionar o señalar algo.

words.definition: To get money for work you do.
words.example: She earns a good salary.

gloss.es: Recibir dinero por el trabajo.

words.definition: To explain the meaning of a word.
words.example: Can you define this term?

gloss.es: Explicar el significado de una palabra.

words.definition: To help someone by giving money, help, or approval.
words.example: My family supports my decision.

gloss.es: Ayudar a alguien con dinero, ayuda o aprobación.

words.definition: To go to an event or place.
words.example: Many people attended the concert.

gloss.es: Ir a un evento o lugar.

words.definition: To have something as a part.
words.example: The price includes breakfast.

gloss.es: Tener algo como parte.

words.definition: To appear to be.
words.example: You seem tired.

gloss.es: Dar la impresión de algo.

words.definition: To give what is needed.
words.example: We provide free water.

gloss.es: Dar lo que hace falta.

words.definition: To present something to accept or refuse.
words.example: They offer good service.

gloss.es: Presentar algo para aceptar o rechazar.

words.definition: To guide or be in charge.
words.example: She leads the team.

gloss.es: Guiar o estar a cargo.

words.definition: To become larger in number.
words.example: Prices increase every year.

gloss.es: Hacerse mayor en número.

words.definition: To think carefully about something before deciding
words.example: Please consider my offer before you answer.

gloss.es: Pensar con cuidado en algo antes de decidir.

gloss_example.es: Considera mi oferta antes de responder.

words.definition: To believe that something will happen
words.example: I expect the train to arrive on time.

gloss.es: Creer que algo va a suceder.

gloss_example.es: Espero que el tren llegue a tiempo.

words.definition: To give permission for something
words.example: They don't allow phones in class.

gloss.es: Dar permiso para algo.

words.definition: To offer an idea or a plan for someone to think about
words.example: I suggest leaving early to avoid traffic.

gloss.es: Ofrecer una idea o un plan para que alguien lo considere.

gloss_example.es: Sugiero salir temprano para evitar el tráfico.

words.definition: To grow or to make something grow and improve
words.example: Children develop language skills very quickly.

gloss.es: Crecer o hacer que algo crezca y mejore.

gloss_example.es: Los niños desarrollan el lenguaje muy rápido.

words.definition: To use or divide something together with others
words.example: We share an office with two colleagues.

gloss.es: Usar o dividir algo junto con otras personas.

words.definition: To make something new exist
words.example: She wants to create her own company.

gloss.es: Hacer que algo nuevo exista.

gloss_example.es: Ella quiere crear su propia empresa.

words.definition: To get something that is given or sent to you
words.example: Did you receive my message yesterday?

gloss.es: Obtener algo que te dan o te envían.

words.definition: To need something, or to demand it officially
words.example: This job requires experience with computers.

gloss.es: Necesitar algo, o exigirlo de manera oficial.

gloss_example.es: Este trabajo requiere experiencia con computadoras.

words.definition: To make or grow something
words.example: This factory produces electric cars.

gloss.es: Fabricar o cultivar algo.

words.definition: To say what someone or something is like
words.example: Can you describe the man you saw?

gloss.es: Decir cómo es alguien o algo.

words.definition: To say yes to something that is offered
words.example: She decided to accept the job offer.

gloss.es: Decir que sí a algo que se ofrece.

gloss_example.es: Decidió aceptar la oferta de trabajo.

words.definition: To stay away from something or stop it from happening
words.example: I avoid driving during rush hour.

gloss.es: Mantenerse lejos de algo o impedir que suceda.

words.definition: To arrive at a place or point, or to stretch out to touch something
words.example: We reached the top of the hill.

gloss.es: Llegar a un lugar o punto, o estirarse para tocar algo.

gloss_example.es: Alcanzamos la cima de la colina.

words.definition: To talk about something with others
words.example: Let's discuss the plan tomorrow.

gloss.es: Hablar de algo con otras personas.

words.definition: To make a formal request, usually in writing
words.example: I want to apply for that job.

gloss.es: Hacer una solicitud formal, por lo general por escrito.

words.definition: To tell people someone's name for the first time
words.example: Let me introduce my colleague.

gloss.es: Decir el nombre de alguien por primera vez a otros.

words.definition: To see or become aware of something
words.example: I didn't notice the sign.

gloss.es: Ver algo o darse cuenta de ello.

words.definition: To arrange things or plan an event in an orderly way
words.example: She organized the whole trip.

gloss.es: Ordenar cosas o planear un evento de forma ordenada.

words.definition: To do an action, or to act, sing, or play for an audience
words.example: The band will perform tonight.

gloss.es: Realizar una acción, o actuar, cantar o tocar ante un público.

words.definition: To find something for the first time
words.example: Scientists discovered a new planet.

gloss.es: Encontrar algo por primera vez.

gloss_example.es: Los científicos descubrieron un nuevo planeta.

words.definition: To put a new thing in place of an old one
words.example: We need to replace the batteries.

gloss.es: Poner algo nuevo en lugar de algo viejo.

words.definition: To make something longer or last more time
words.example: Can I extend my stay one night?

gloss.es: Hacer que algo sea más largo o dure más tiempo.

words.definition: To be decided by something else, or to need someone for support
words.example: Our plans depend on the weather.

gloss.es: Estar decidido por otra cosa, o necesitar a alguien para apoyarse.

words.definition: To disagree with someone, often angrily
words.example: They always argue about money.

gloss.es: Estar en desacuerdo con alguien, a veces con enojo.

words.definition: To act or speak on behalf of a person or group
words.example: She represents our region.

gloss.es: Actuar o hablar en nombre de una persona o grupo.

words.definition: To cause a change in something
words.example: The rain affected the crops.

gloss.es: Causar un cambio en algo.

words.definition: To make something smaller in size or amount
words.example: We must reduce our costs.

gloss.es: Hacer que algo sea menor en tamaño o cantidad.

words.definition: To try to find or get something
words.example: They seek a better life.

gloss.es: Tratar de encontrar o conseguir algo.

words.definition: To usually do something or behave in a certain way
words.example: I tend to wake up early.

gloss.es: Hacer algo habitualmente o comportarse de cierta manera.

words.definition: To make a machine work, or to run a business
words.example: Do you know how to operate this machine?

gloss.es: Hacer funcionar una máquina, o dirigir un negocio.

words.definition: To think carefully, or to show an image like a mirror
words.example: I need time to reflect on this.

gloss.es: Pensar con cuidado, o mostrar una imagen como un espejo.

gloss_example.es: Necesito tiempo para reflexionar sobre esto.

words.definition: To feel sad because someone is not there, or to fail to catch something
words.example: I miss my family a lot.

gloss.es: Sentir tristeza porque alguien no está, o no lograr tomar algo.

words.definition: To feel uneasy about something that might happen
words.example: Don't worry, everything is fine.

gloss.es: Sentir intranquilidad por algo que podría pasar.

gloss_example.es: No te preocupes, todo está bien.

words.definition: To make a living thing die
words.example: Frost can kill the plants.

gloss.es: Hacer que un ser vivo muera.

gloss_example.es: La helada puede matar las plantas.

words.definition: To accept or deal with something difficult
words.example: I can't bear this heat.

gloss.es: Aceptar o sobrellevar algo difícil.

words.definition: To suggest a plan or idea formally
words.example: I propose a short break.

gloss.es: Sugerir un plan o idea de manera formal.

words.definition: To give someone confidence or support to do something
words.example: My teacher encouraged me to try again.

gloss.es: Dar confianza o apoyo a alguien para que haga algo.

gloss_example.es: Mi maestra me animó a intentarlo de nuevo.

words.definition: To keep someone or something safe from harm.
words.example: Helmets protect your head.

gloss.es: Mantener a alguien o algo a salvo del daño.

words.definition: To be real or present in the world.
words.example: Few of these animals still exist.

gloss.es: Ser real o estar presente en el mundo.

gloss_example.es: Pocos de estos animales todavía existen.

words.definition: To divide or keep things apart.
words.example: Please separate the plastic from the paper.

gloss.es: Dividir o mantener cosas apartadas.

gloss_example.es: Por favor, separa el plástico del papel.

words.definition: To push something firmly.
words.example: Press the button to start.

gloss.es: Empujar algo con firmeza.

words.definition: To move upward or increase.
words.example: Prices rise every year.

gloss.es: Moverse hacia arriba o aumentar.

words.definition: To do something or behave in a certain way.
words.example: We must act quickly.

gloss.es: Hacer algo o comportarse de cierta manera.

words.definition: To point or direct toward a goal.
words.example: They aim to finish by Friday.

gloss.es: Dirigir algo hacia un objetivo.

gloss_example.es: Apuntan a terminar para el viernes.
